description: Every language-model and Jev prompt in the runtime: a stable id, a version, its purpose, input and output contract, and a changelog. A prompt is the exact source of the declarations listed. Its fingerprint (prompts/fingerprint.mjs) must equal the latest changelog entry, so any change to a prompt needs a new version and changelog entry. runtimeVersion names the constant the runtime records with its output, where one exists.

prompts.purpose: Transcript review judge (language-model path): product-quality review of an anonymised production conversation.
prompts.input: A transcript record (bounded conversation, typed state evidence) and the review time.
prompts.output: JSON review: overall, outcome, understanding, diagnostic, conversation and flags (schema.js).

changelog.change: Registered unchanged in Phase 8. Content as deployed on 2026-10-09.

prompts.purpose: Transcript review judge (Jev path): the same review as typed Jev questions.
prompts.input: The judge context of review.transcript.llm and a reviewer role.
prompts.output: Typed Jev answers, assessed into the review schema.

changelog.change: Registered unchanged in Phase 8. Content as deployed on 2026-10-09.

prompts.purpose: ACQ-100 subjective quality judge (legacy, non-authoritative): scores reasoning, question quality and answer quality of an anonymised journey.
prompts.input: A journey (structured gold) and an anonymised transcript.
prompts.output: JSON with three 0-100 scores and reasons.

changelog.change: Registered unchanged in Phase 8. Content as deployed on 2026-10-09.
